personality_one_liner: A cinematic, high-contrast premium AI ecosystem relying heavily on structural glass, polished silver surfaces, deep black typography for extreme clarity, and controlled blue-white/gold energy accents.

spacing.rule: Generous, architectural spacing. Cinematic layouts require breathing room around central UI entities to emphasize scale and importance.

do's: Use heavily on Portal entrance cards, Hub center nodes, and hovering status bars.
Pair with a ≥70% #FFFFFF base tint in light mode so underlying particles/images don't break typography readability.
Use glass headers fading into transparent for cinematic scroll experiences.
dont's: Don't stack glass on top of glass.
Don't use glass for standard form inputs or heavy text-reading sections.

screens.name: Cinematic Intro
screens.purpose: A cinematic opening sequence anchoring the AI to Toronto and revealing The Guardian.

states.loading: Skia-rendered Toronto skyline silhouette at golden hour, transitioning to cinematic night.

screens.layout: Full-bleed absolute Skia Canvas. Sequence: CN Tower skyline pan -> Boy silhouette looking up -> Superhero-scale Guardian energy arrival (lightning/cyan energy shaders) -> 7 dimensional portals open sequentially via Reanimated scale/opacity. Stack navigation pushes to Landing Page.

screens.name: Landing Page
screens.purpose: First touchpoint post-intro offering Demo Mode, Auth, and brand hero messaging.
screens.layout: Bottom-weighted cinematic layout. Top 60% is an abstract floating crystal/energy visual. Bottom 40% houses the primary CTAs ('Get Started', 'Experience Demo' inside a glass container). Deep black primary buttons with subtle gold glow on press.

screens.name: Main Hub (Guardian View)
screens.purpose: The central nervous system of the Life House, visualizing Cross-Life Context Intelligence.

states.error: Orb turns soft red; displays fallback local intelligence.

screens.layout: Radial Hub. Guardian orb resides at absolute center (Skia glowing orb with voice wave visualizer). The 7 portals (Work, Home, Wellbeing, etc.) orbit radially. Reanimated lines connect portals to visualize cross-context (e.g., Work -> Wellbeing). Companion AI (Kaia/Atlas) switcher toggle floating top-right.

screens.name: Portal Detail (e.g., Wellbeing)
screens.purpose: Specific dashboard for a single life portal, retaining the premium glass aesthetic.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with soft glass shimmer.
states.empty: Large atmospheric photo (e.g., wellness spa) + 'Awaiting data' message in deep black.
states.error: Minimalist error state with elegant 'Retry' pill button.

screens.layout: Cinematic header with a parallax background photo overlaid with top-to-bottom white-to-glass scrim. Content sits on frosted glass cards with 1pt silver borders. Metrics (mood, routines) use high-contrast black typography on white cards.

screens.name: Privacy & Portal Access
screens.purpose: Settings controlling autonomy, AI access, and companion persona.
screens.layout: List-based structural layout. Glass rows over a static luminous silver background. Toggles use deep black when active, silver when inactive. 'Companion Selector' is a segmented control or horizontal glass carousel (Guardian / Kaia / Atlas).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the custom '6 Glass / Luxe (Luminous Light Mode)' aesthetic. DO NOT default to a dark/cyberpunk UI. The app is bright, silver, luminous, and luxurious. Rely on extreme contrast (pure white backgrounds with deep black #0A0A0A text).

For the Cinematic Intro, use @shopify/react-native-skia. Render the Toronto Skyline silhouette at the bottom, and use Skia shaders/particles to generate the blue-white/cyan energy for the Guardian's arrival.

For the Main Hub, orchestrate a radial UI. Center the Guardian (an animated glowing Skia element or blurred orb). Place the 7 portals radially. Use Reanimated to draw glowing dashed lines between portals to visualize Cross-Life Context (e.g., Work -> Wellbeing).
Fonts: Implement 'ClashDisplay' for headers (premium display sans) and 'Satoshi' for body text. Load these manually rather than using @expo-google-fonts as requested.

Component Styling: Primary CTAs should be deep black (#0A0A0A) with white text, triggering a very subtle gold/champagne glow on press. Portal cards must use expo-blur over a light silver base with a 0.5pt silver border.

All imagery (Toronto, Work, Wellbeing, etc.) MUST utilize the top-to-bottom white-to-glass gradient scrim pattern (detailed in <Imagery_and_Texture>) so the black typography remains perfectly legible against high-end photography.
